# API Naming and JavaDoc

## Naming

| Type | Naming |
|---|---|
| Controller | `XxxController` |
| Service | `XxxService` |
| Mapper | `XxxMapper` |
| DTO | `XxxDto` |
| Entity | `XxxEntity` |
| Constants | `XxxConstants` |
| Exception | `XxxException` |

## JavaDoc

Class, Interface, Enum, and public/protected methods must have Japanese JavaDoc. Describe the 処理概要 and include `@param`, `@return`, and `@throws` as needed. Do not write comments that merely repeat the code.
